scholarships.title: Türkiye Scholarships - IsDB Joint Scholarship Program
scholarships.funding_label: Fully Funded with Repayment Obligation at Associate and Bachelor's Level
scholarships.official_source: Presidency for Turks Abroad and Related Communities (YTB)

existing.description: A Türkiye Scholarships programme co-funded by the Presidency for Turks Abroad and Related Communities and the Islamic Development Bank, enabling high-achieving students from IsDB member countries and Muslim communities in other countries to study at internationally recognised universities in Türkiye. Scholarships are offered at associate, bachelor's, master's and PhD level and cover a monthly stipend, accommodation support, tuition fees, health insurance, a one-year Turkish language course and a one-time round-trip airfare. Associate and bachelor degree holders are required to repay the loan to the IsDB Education Trust after graduation and employment.
eligibility: Successful international students from IsDB member countries
Students from Muslim communities around the world living outside IsDB member countries
Minimum academic achievement of 70% for associate and bachelor's degree candidates
Minimum academic achievement of 75% for graduate candidates
Minimum academic achievement of 90% for candidates of Health Sciences (Medicine, Dentistry and Pharmacy)
Under 21 years of age for associate and bachelor's degree programmes
Under 30 years of age for master's programmes
Under 35 years of age for PhD programmes
Not a Turkish citizen and not a person who has lost Turkish citizenship
Not currently enrolled in a programme in Turkish universities at the level of education applied for
existing.eligibility_summary: High-achieving students from IsDB member countries and Muslim communities living in other countries, applying at associate, bachelor's, master's or PhD level. Turkish citizens and those who have lost Turkish citizenship are ineligible, as are individuals already enrolled in a programme at a Turkish university at the level applied for.
requirements: Apply through the Türkiye Scholarships official website only
Select 'Yes' under the 'Joint Scholarship Programs' section on the application screen in order to be considered for the joint programme
Choose a programme and department from the published list of eligible fields of study and countries
Meet the Türkiye Scholarships minimum academic achievement and age criteria for the level applied for
documents: Valid identity document, ID card or passport
Photograph taken within the last 1 year
International exam results such as GRE, GMAT or SAT if required by the chosen university or programme
International language test results such as TOEFL or DELF if required by the chosen university or programme
Research topic proposal and a written example of research carried out, for PhD applications only
application_method: Register on the Türkiye Scholarships application system at https://tbbs.turkiyeburslari.gov.tr
Select 'Yes' under the 'Joint Scholarship Programs' section on the application screen
Choose an eligible programme, department and country from the published list
Upload all required documents and submit the application within the published window
existing.selection_notes: The programme aims to support promising students in fields aligned with the Sustainable Development Goals and to contribute to the academic, cultural, social, political and economic development of developing countries. Candidates are selected through the Türkiye Scholarships evaluation and selection process, which the awarding body publishes separately.
existing.best_fit: High-achieving students from IsDB member countries and Muslim communities in other countries who can satisfy the level-specific academic percentage and age limits and want to study in Türkiye.
existing.notes: Repayment obligation: the awarding body states that associate degree and bachelor degree students are required to repay the loan after graduation and employment, in easy instalments, to the IsDB Education Trust, a Waqf set up in the students' countries. Because of that obligation the award is not treated as unconditionally fully funded. Applications are accepted only through the Türkiye Scholarships official website, and the joint programme is selected within the same application rather than by a separate form.
existing.application_period: The 2026 application period ran 10 January to 20 February 2026. Türkiye Scholarships publishes a General Application Period of 10 January to 20 February in its Application Calendar, so the next window falls in January and February 2027.
existing.program_type: Government-funded bilateral scholarship for developing countries, co-funded with the Islamic Development Bank
